taxa.parent_formula: Muhlenbergia lindheimeri Hitchc. × Muhlenbergia reverchonii Vasey & Scribn.
taxa.parent_name_verification: Both parents accepted separately in POWO/WCVP 2026; do not treat either parent as a synonym of the hybrid.
taxa.synonym_verification: No synonyms enumerated on the POWO hybrid taxon page as reviewed; typographic 'x' and multiplication sign '×' are search/format variants, not separate species concepts or evidence of synonymy.
taxa.identity_hold: The existence and accepted parentage of the named hybrid do not establish that the learner's source-labelled images are a vouchered individual hybrid. Preserve existing PROVISIONAL and independent floret/ligule voucher HOLD; no individual or photograph promoted to confirmed.

source_conflict.subject: fertile lemma length
source_conflict.interpretation: Potential treatment/measurement inconsistency; do not silently harmonize or substitute one measurement in species card. Verify against original Swallen protologue and a measured voucher before any diagnostic species-level change.

taxa.proposed_action: Keep existing hybrid card distinct from both parent species; retain multiplication-sign rank, Swallen authorship and parent formula. Preserve all scientific holds. No canonical, gallery, genus, nativity, or publication changes.
